prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production CONNECTED MOUNTAIN AUTOTILE sheet for a top-down 1990s fantasy strategy game. Exactly 4 columns x4 rows uniform square cells, 16 tiles, no labels, no lines, no margins, transparent background. Original crisp low resolution pixel art, each cell designed at32x32 native pixels then enlarged nearest neighbor, muted neutral grey/brown stone, four-tone rock shading, upper-left lighting, no smooth HD paint. These are NOT arbitrary crops of a larger picture: every cell is a complete specifically drawn terrain junction with a readable rocky peak or slope at its center. Neighbour connections extend continuous textured rocky foothills to the middle of the appropriate cell edges; all unconnected edges have complete irregular mountain silhouettes and transparent outside. Same stone palette and same connection height/width on all pieces. Cells in row-major order use bitmask N=1 E=2 S=4 W=8: row1 masks0 isolated peak,1 connects north,2 east,3 north+east; row2 masks4 south,5 north+south ridge,6 east+south,7 north+east+south; row3 masks8 west,9 north+west,10 east+west horizontal mountain ridge,11 north+east+west; row4 masks12 south+west,13 north+south+west,14 east+south+west,15 all four directions central massif. Horizontal mountain pieces must join naturally into broad mountain ranges with continuous ridgelines, not fence posts. NO grass, sand, houses, cactus, units, rectangular background, clipped photos, checkerboard painted background, visible square seams, text or UI. Alpha transparency must be genuine.
